LanguageData.LP_ReadMind.label: read mind
LanguageData.LP_ReadMind.description: Peek into a humanlike's thoughts: see their traits, best skills, current mood and what they care about most. Used on colony prisoners it also shakes their will: resistance -3. Costs 3 brain matter (free for half-illithids), cooldown 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_Dominate.label: dominate person
LanguageData.LP_Dominate.description: Seize the will of a humanlike not from this colony for 30 seconds: the dominated only attacks its former companions, then collapses exhausted after 30 seconds. Mind resistance can resist it; the psychically deaf are unaffected. Costs 25 brain matter, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_PsychicBind.label: psychic binding
LanguageData.LP_PsychicBind.description: Press the hivemind's doctrine straight into the other's mind: a humanlike of a different belief loses 40 certainty, converting to the caster's ideoligion when certainty reaches zero. Mind resistance can resist it. Only available with Ideology loaded. Costs 20 brain matter, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_TelekineticThrow.label: telekinetic throw
LanguageData.LP_TelekineticThrow.description: Fling a creature up to 4 cells with telekinesis, dealing 10 blunt damage and staggering it for 1 second. Costs 8 brain matter, cooldown 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_Unseen.label: psionic concealment
LanguageData.LP_Unseen.description: Make yourself invisible to all minds around you for 1 hour (uses vanilla psychic invisibility; attacking or being hurt may reveal you). Costs 15 brain matter, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_PsychicStorm.label: psychic storm
LanguageData.LP_PsychicStorm.description: Release a raging psychic storm in 8 cells around you: all hostile targets are stunned for about 6 seconds and suffer psychic concussion, harder to resist than a psychic blast (mind resistance has only half effect). Costs 40 brain matter, cooldown 5 days.
